common_intent_requirements.text: 把一块柔软的布搭在桌边
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 把一块柔软的布搭在桌边
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: Hands place a piece of soft fabric across the edge

common_intent_requirements.text: 大半留在桌上、小半垂下
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 大半留在桌上、小半垂下
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: most of it rests on the tabletop and a smaller portion extends beyond the edge. The hands release the fabric and move clear. The unsupported portion drops into a loose downward drape while the larger portion remains in contact with the table.

common_intent_requirements.text: 拍清它自然落稳的样子
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 拍清它自然落稳的样子
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: The fabric bends over the edge and develops soft folds as its small movements settle.

physics_checks.criterion: 受到桌面支撑的部分与桌面保持接触，越过边缘的柔软部分在重力下弯曲下垂。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 桌沿、布料接触区和悬垂区同时可辨，放手后存在自然变形。
fail_examples: 悬空布料像硬板一样水平伸出且没有支撑
布料放手后无外力向上飘起并定住
not_required: 褶皱形状、摆动次数和具体下垂长度可以不同
不要求完全无滑移或像素级稳定

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
